title: Window manager
summary: Focus, fullscreen, workspace, close, split-ratio notch, group next, dwindle or master. special workspace stays a workspace. No pixel click.

title: Audio
summary: Default sink volume and mute in notches. PipeWire / WirePlumber.

title: Launcher
summary: Allowlisted exec. If already running, focuses instead.

title: Mail
summary: Ask-first inbox. Open last message needs confirm. Send is not a page.
driver: notmuch / local IMAP index over a unix socket
snap: account bound to speaker + contact book + unread counts

title: Media
summary: Play, pause, skip, now-playing. Playerctl or Jellyfin socket.

title: BuckyBoi
summary: Overlay buddy verbs. Identity stays in BuckyBoi; Vikett only offers doors.

title: Scenes
summary: GlassSpear named recipes. House-scale apply_scene / lock_private.
snap: scene library + active scene per surface

title: Notifications
summary: Read last notification (private), dismiss one, dismiss all (confirm). No arbitrary D-Bus.

title: Lights
summary: Home Assistant adapter. Closed scenes only — no free entity IDs.

title: Timer
summary: Kitchen / desk timer. Amounts are notches, not invented minutes from the model.
snap: running timer seconds remaining or null

title: Calendar
summary: Ask what is next. Never invents a meeting or sends an invite.
driver: local CalDAV / khal over unix socket
snap: next event bound to speaker, hidden with guests

title: Display
summary: Panel brightness and a per-output notch for authored hdmi or edp. No free resolution or refresh. Layout presets stay reserved.

title: Climate
summary: Room climate group, notches only. No free setpoints.
snap: current C or null if no climate entity in this room

title: Capture
summary: Screenshot the focused output. Clipboard paste is not a page.

title: Weather
summary: Local forecast string. Not a chat about packing.
driver: HA weather entity / wttr.in LAN cache
snap: short condition or null if offline

title: Browser
summary: Shared doors plus Firefox containers, Chrome profiles, and Zen workspace, sidebar, and split chords.
driver: hl.dsp.focus + hl.dsp.send_shortcut from keymap; exec_cmd only for unmapped focus

title: Terminal
summary: Foot, Kitty, Ghostty, Alacritty, and WezTerm. Focus may exec. New window never does.
driver: hl.dsp.focus + hl.dsp.send_shortcut from keymap; exec_cmd only for unmapped focus

title: Files
summary: Nautilus, Nemo, Thunar, Dolphin, and Yazi. Open only authored directory ids. Trash confirms.
driver: hl.dsp.focus + hl.dsp.send_shortcut from keymap; exec_cmd for an authored folder

title: Notes
summary: Obsidian, Logseq, and Joplin. Daily and vault are private. No paragraph slot.

title: Reader
summary: Zathura, Evince, Papers, and Foliate. Next and previous page, chapter, zoom notch, dark. No page number.

title: Chat
summary: Signal, Element, and Vesktop. Focus when mapped. Mute and mark-read stay reserved. Unread is a private bucket. No send.
driver: hl.dsp.focus when mapped; send_shortcut only if a chord exists

title: Music
summary: Spotify, ncspot, Strawberry, Amberol, and MPD. Play, next, seek notch, and an authored playlist. Volume stays audio. Not bare pause or next.

title: Video
summary: mpv, VLC, and Jellyfin. Seek notch, VLC chapter and subs. Fullscreen and PiP stay reserved. No free title.
driver: playerctl -p <app> or hl.dsp.send_shortcut. Focus may hl.dsp.exec_cmd

title: Images
summary: Loupe and imv. Zoom notch when a modifier chord exists. Next and trash stay reserved. Trash confirms.
